# Test fixtures

Place only small, redistributable product samples here. For each fixture record:

- product and processor/version;
- source or generation method;
- transformations used to reduce/anonymize it;
- redistribution permission or license;
- reader behavior the fixture protects.

Prefer synthetic files generated inside a test unless real group structure,
encoding or metadata is essential. Never add credentials, personal paths, a
complete operational granule or data whose redistribution status is unclear.
